parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer raises a concern about the stability of the proposed method when stacking multiple layers of WLS units, since the failure probability of stochastic/random projection compounds across layers. It explicitly states an action—that the authors should justify the stability of the proposed method—and asks clarification questions ('How stable is the proposed method? And what happens when stacking more layers?'). These questions do not themselves provide a direct, applicable action, so the main actionable element is the explicit request to justify stability. However, the comment is vague on how to execute this action: it specifies no experiments, analyses, or methods the authors could use to demonstrate stability. The comment therefore gives authors a clear direction but lacks concrete implementation details, which corresponds to the rubric category where an action is explicitly stated but vague on how to carry it out.
